name: 反応とリアクション追加
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE actual Lighthouse component LH03-0013「反応とリアクション追加」.
PRIMARY ORIGINAL Image1 controls the actual reaction artwork/meaning, selected-state cues, icon glyph geometry, optical weight, proportions and fine spacing. Mock Image2 is SECONDARY for count1 and logical70x32px selected pill plus36x32px add-reaction button; do NOT copy its inaccurate smile substitutions.
Two compact adjacent controls on pure white#FFFFFF canvas. Left: white rounded reaction pill with a fine forest-green#1F6444 outline, preserving ORIGINAL selected-reaction meaning (source blue/lavender selected pill adapted to green OUTLINE, no tinted fill). Inside, preserve ORIGINAL red HUNDRED-POINTS emoji/artwork「💯」with slanted handwritten100 and double underline, then exact count「1」in MeiryoRegular logical12px/16px,tracking0, slate#526173. Do not replace hundred-points reaction with a smile, heart or different emoji. Its red artwork color is protected content, not random UI decoration.
Right: quiet white rounded add-reaction button, fine neutral outline, with the ORIGINAL small FILLED slate circular smiling face: white small eyes and white curved smile cutout, source-faithful rounded proportions and weight. Not an outlined smile from our mock, no plus glyph because source shows none. Both controls same32px logical height, image glyphs20px logical, compact gap. Gentle restrained shadow if useful, no heavy elevation.
Landscape3:1 output, ONE pair centered and uniformly enlarged, modest white margins. No captions, labels, extra counts, additional controls, heading, phone, message text, screen or duplicated states. Crisp source-like fine details and readable count1. White surfaces remain white; no mint fills or purple/blue primary button.
reviewNotes: 原画像の実際の反応は赤い100の二重下線であり、モックの笑顔置換は意味を変えていたため原画像優先で復元。選択の青/薄紫は白面の森林緑輪郭へ、追加笑顔は原画像のスレート塗りと白い目/口へ適応。実画像を目視し💯形状・件数1・2操作・白面・ミントなしを確認。絵文字画素同一性、正確な字体計測・反応動作・ネイティブ編集・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
